paragraphs.text: Which might put him in remembrance of his deliverance.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He teaches us to be earnest in prayer even though God seems to delay: for at his time he will hear us.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He was assured that the more they raged, the nearer they were to destruction, and he the nearer to his deliverance.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: By this we are taught not to mock at others in their misery, lest the same fall on our own necks.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Because he had felt God's help before, he grounds on experience, and boldly seeks him for help.
